concerns.text: Task T024 implements Group K-Fold, explicitly overriding Spec FR-003 (Stratified K-Fold). While the Plan.md notes this deviation, the task itself executes a constraint violation without a formal Spec amendment or 'Kickback' acceptance recorded in the tasks. This silently relaxes the validation strategy mandated by the Spec.

Task T025-ALT implements a 'Mass-Only Model' baseline, overriding Spec SC-003 which defines the baseline as the Linear Mixing Rule (ρ_baseline). This changes the statistical null hypothesis (from 'non-linear effects exist' to 'packing descriptors add value over mass alone') without a formal Spec change, violating the requirement to measure against the defined baseline.

Task T014 states the strategy is to 'Filter rows with missing density values (do not impute)'. Spec FR-001 and US-1 require the system to switch to 'Pipeline Validation Mode' (synthetic data) if the dataset is insufficient (<50 rows) or if sources fail. Filtering rows without a fallback mechanism risks leaving the pipeline with <50 rows, violating the data sufficiency constraint.

Task T020 lists only 4 descriptors (Mean Atomic Mass, Mean Atomic Radius, Electronegativity Variance, Atomic Radius Mismatch), omitting the 'Packing Efficiency Proxy' required by Spec FR-002. While T021 handles the proxy separately, T020's description fails to explicitly cover the full set of 5 required descriptors, creating a traceability gap and risk of partial implementation.
